3 Of The Best Pre-Built PCs That Are Cheaper Than Building One Yourself In 2026
DDR5 Memory in 2026: Prices, Supply and Speed Tiers Explained
Steam Machine priced at $1,049, Valve officially confirms

en.commentary:
The advice I gave for fifteen years, that you should build your own machine to save money, expired this year. A 32GB DDR5-6000 kit that sold for roughly $80 in mid-2025 is asking about $432 today, July alone added another 7% to DDR5 contract pricing, and the market now sits 448% above where it was twelve months ago. The big system builders bought memory and NAND by the container before the spike and locked those costs in, so a boxed machine in August 2026 frequently lands under the cart of parts that would recreate it. I have priced that comparison four times this month and the prebuilt won every time.

That makes the Valve Steam Machine the most useful object in this entire category. Valve states plainly that it sells the box at cost, which turns the $1,049 sticker into a public receipt for what June 2026 silicon really costs. Roughly six times Steam Deck graphics performance for that money is the line every other machine here has to clear. It lands at second because SteamOS runs about 25,000 games and your library probably includes titles outside that set, and because Valve is still working through a reservation queue it expects to clear by year end.

The Lenovo Legion Tower 7i Gen 10 takes the top spot at $1,709 for an RTX 5070 Ti, a Core Ultra 7 265F, 32GB of DDR5 and a 1200W supply. Divide the frame rate by that price and it wins outright, and the internals are a standard ATX board with a standard 24-pin connector, so the machine stays alive through two more GPU generations.

One habit will save you more money than any brand choice: order the base memory configuration and buy your own sticks. The factory 16GB to 32GB upgrade currently runs between $120 and $360 depending on the brand, for the same commodity DIMMs.

highlights.title: The Steam Machine is the ruler every other box gets measured with
highlights.body: Valve confirmed it sells the Steam Machine at cost, $1,049 for the 512GB model and $1,349 for the 2TB version, and said the original target was closer to $750 before memory and NAND pricing moved. That makes it the only machine in this category with a published, honest bill of materials attached to it. I use it as a baseline: any Windows tower asking more than $1,049 needs to show clearly more performance for the difference. That single test replaces an afternoon of spec-sheet reading, and it is the reason a $2,399 machine with an RTX 5070 scores where it does on cost per frame.

highlights.title: Lenovo wins because $1,709 buys an RTX 5070 Ti you can still swap out later
highlights.body: The Legion Tower 7i Gen 10 pairs an RTX 5070 Ti and Core Ultra 7 265F with 32GB of DDR5, a 2TB NVMe on the higher trim and a 1200W power supply, and it does that on a standard ATX motherboard with a standard 24-pin connector. The 1200W headroom matters more than the benchmark numbers. It means the next GPU generation drops straight in, and in a year where components cost what they cost, a chassis that accepts a staged upgrade is worth several hundred dollars on its own. The RTX 5080 trim at $2,089 keeps the same logic intact.

highlights.title: Order the base memory and buy your own sticks, every single time
highlights.body: Factory memory upgrades became the highest-margin line item on a 2026 configurator. Going from 16GB to 32GB at checkout runs from about $120 at the value brands to roughly $360 at the premium ones, for identical commodity DDR5 DIMMs that cost the manufacturer the same. Buy the machine at its base memory tier, then add a matched kit yourself. DDR5 is expensive at retail too, and this move still comes out ahead by $80 to $250 depending on the brand. It takes four minutes and one screwdriver.

highlights.title: Cost per frame is the only number that compares brands honestly
highlights.body: Spec sheets flatter machines that stack impressive part names at whatever price the vendor likes. Measured average frame rate divided by the actual transaction price cuts through that immediately. Run it across this list and the ordering falls out on its own: Lenovo at $1,709 with an RTX 5070 Ti sits at the top, Skytech and CyberPowerPC hold the value end at $649 to $799, and the boutique builds at $3,000 and up are buying you assembly craft and support rather than throughput. Decide which of those two things you are actually paying for.

highlights.title: Check the power supply wattage and the motherboard standard before anything else
highlights.body: A prebuilt with a proprietary board layout or a 500W supply is a machine that ends its life the day its GPU does. That has always been true, and in 2026 it costs real money, because staged upgrades are how most people will get through the current component prices. The Omen 35L, the Legion Tower 7i, the iBUYPOWER Y40 Pro, the Corsair Vengeance i7500 and the Maingear MG-1 all use retail ATX internals throughout. Confirm the wattage, the board form factor and the maximum GPU length the chassis accepts, then look at the benchmark charts.

zh-tw.commentary:
老實說，「自己組比較便宜」這句話我講了十五年，今年正式失效了。

2025 年中一組 32GB DDR5-6000 大概兩千五出頭就買得到，現在同一組要一萬三千多，光是七月 DDR5 合約價又漲了 7%，整體比一年前高出 448%。大型整機廠在漲價前用貨櫃單位掃記憶體跟 NAND，成本早就鎖死了，所以 2026 年 8 月的品牌機價格，常常比你照著同樣規格去原價屋開單還便宜。這個比較我這個月自己算過四次，四次都是品牌機贏。

也因為這樣，Valve Steam Machine 在這一題裡是最有參考價值的一台。Valve 直接講明成本價出貨，1,049 美元這個數字等於把 2026 年 6 月的真實零件成本公開標價，換算台幣大約三萬三，效能約是 Steam Deck 的六倍。任何一台比它貴的機器，都得拿出對得起價差的效能。它排在第二，理由很實際：SteamOS 目前約有兩萬五千款遊戲能跑，你手上那幾款很可能剛好在名單外，而且台灣沒有正式通路，要買得靠代購。

第一名我給 Lenovo Legion Tower 7i Gen 10。NT$53,900 買到 RTX 5070 Ti、Core Ultra 7 265F、32GB DDR5、1200W 電源，用幀數去除價格它直接勝出，而且裡面是標準 ATX 主機板配標準 24pin 電源，這台可以再撐兩代顯卡。

最後講一個能幫你省最多錢的習慣，跟你選哪個品牌無關：下單就選最低的記憶體配置，記憶體自己買自己插。原廠 16GB 升 32GB 的加價，各家從三千八到一萬一都有，插的是規格完全一樣的通用 DDR5。

highlights.title: Steam Machine 是全站排序的那把尺
highlights.body: Valve 公開表示 Steam Machine 以成本價販售，512GB 版 1,049 美元、2TB 版 1,349 美元，並說明原本的目標價接近 750 美元，價差全部來自記憶體與 NAND 漲價。這代表它是這個品類裡唯一一台把料件成本誠實攤開的機器。我把它當基準線用：任何一台 Windows 品牌機開價超過台幣三萬三，就得拿出明顯更高的效能來對應那個價差。這一招可以幫你省掉一整個下午的規格表比對，也是為什麼一台要價七萬五、只配 RTX 5070 的機器，在每幀成本這一項會落在現在的位置。

highlights.title: Lenovo 拿第一，是因為五萬三買到的 RTX 5070 Ti 之後還能自己換掉
highlights.body: Legion Tower 7i Gen 10 用 RTX 5070 Ti 配 Core Ultra 7 265F、32GB DDR5，高階配置給到 2TB NVMe，電源直接上 1200W，而且主機板是標準 ATX、電源接頭是標準 24pin。1200W 這個數字比跑分還重要，它的意思是下一代顯卡買回來直接插上去就能動。在零件價格這麼硬的年份，一台能讓你分階段升級的機殼，本身就值好幾千塊。RTX 5080 的配置賣 NT$65,900 左右，同樣的邏輯依然成立。

highlights.title: 記憶體一律選最低配，剩下的自己插
highlights.body: 原廠記憶體升級在 2026 年變成配置頁上毛利最高的一欄。結帳時從 16GB 升到 32GB，平價品牌加價大約三千八，高階品牌可以喊到一萬一，插的是成本完全相同的通用 DDR5 顆粒。正確做法是機器買最低記憶體配置，然後自己去買一組對稱的套條回來插。零售的 DDR5 現在也不便宜，但這樣做仍然能省下兩千五到八千不等，看你買的是哪個品牌。整個過程四分鐘，一支螺絲起子就搞定。

highlights.title: 每幀成本是唯一能誠實橫向比較的數字
highlights.body: 規格表對那種堆滿漂亮料號、價格隨廠商開的機器特別友善。用實測平均幀數去除實際成交價，這層濾鏡馬上就破了。把這條公式套進這份榜單，排序自己就跑出來了：Lenovo 用 NT$53,900 配 RTX 5070 Ti 站上第一，Skytech 跟 CyberPowerPC 以兩萬到兩萬五守住入門段，而九萬以上的精品組裝機，你買的是組裝工藝跟售後服務。先想清楚你花的這筆錢要換哪一樣。

highlights.title: 先看電源瓦數跟主機板規格，再去看跑分
highlights.body: 一台用專屬主機板、配 500W 電源的品牌機，壽命會跟它那張顯卡一起結束。這件事一直都成立，只是在 2026 年它變成真金白銀的損失，因為多數人接下來都得靠分階段升級撐過這波零件行情。Omen 35L、Legion Tower 7i、iBUYPOWER Y40 Pro、Corsair Vengeance i7500 跟 Maingear MG-1 全部走市售 ATX 規格。買之前先確認三件事：電源瓦數、主機板板型、機殼能塞多長的顯卡，確認完再去看跑分圖表。

en.commentary: The Lenovo Legion Tower 7i Gen 10 holds first because it delivers the best cost per frame in this ranking while using standard components you can replace yourself. Proprietary motherboards and power supplies are what turn a prebuilt into a dead end, and Lenovo avoided that trap. The Valve Steam Machine at 9.0 is the most interesting entry here because it removes Windows overhead entirely and its pricing reflects a company that is not marking up memory. HP Omen 35L at 8.8 offers strong thermals and a clean interior layout. iBUYPOWER Y40 Pro at 8.6 delivers good value with component transparency. Skytech Nebula at 8.3 is the budget entry. My practical guidance for this market: memory pricing has been the defining factor in prebuilt value this year, and several vendors mark up RAM substantially above component cost. Check the specification against current part prices before assuming a prebuilt saves money. Upgrade freedom matters more than people realise at purchase time, since a machine with a standard ATX power supply and socketed components stays useful for years longer than one with proprietary parts.

highlights.title: Standard components prevent a dead end
highlights.body: Proprietary motherboards and power supplies turn a prebuilt into a machine you cannot upgrade. Lenovo uses replaceable parts throughout, which keeps the Legion Tower useful years after a locked-down system becomes disposable.

highlights.title: Steam Machine removes Windows overhead
highlights.body: Valve's approach eliminates the operating system tax and the pricing reflects a company not marking up memory. For a dedicated gaming box that focus produces a genuinely different value proposition.

highlights.title: Check memory markup before buying
highlights.body: Several vendors price RAM substantially above component cost, which has been the defining factor in prebuilt value this year. Compare the specification against current part prices before assuming a prebuilt saves money.

highlights.title: Upgrade freedom outlasts the specification
highlights.body: A standard ATX power supply and socketed components keep a machine useful for years after its original configuration ages out. That flexibility matters more at year four than any benchmark advantage at purchase.

zh-tw.commentary:
Lenovo Legion Tower 7i Gen 10 守第一，因為它在這份榜單裡的每幀成本最好，而且用的是你自己就能更換的標準零件。專屬主機板跟專屬電源供應器，正是讓品牌機變成死路的東西，而 Lenovo 避開了這個坑。

Valve Steam Machine 拿 9.0，是這裡最有意思的一台，它完全拿掉了 Windows 的包袱，定價也反映出一家沒有在記憶體上加價的公司。

HP Omen 35L 8.8 散熱好、內部走線乾淨。iBUYPOWER Y40 Pro 8.6 CP 值不錯，零件標示也透明。Skytech Nebula 8.3 是預算型入門。

給這個市場的實用建議：今年決定品牌機划不划算的關鍵一直是記憶體定價，好幾家廠商的 RAM 加價幅度遠超過零件成本。在斷定買品牌機比較省之前，先拿規格去對現在的零件行情。

另外，升級自由度的重要性比大家買的當下想的高。一台用標準 ATX 電源、零件都是可插拔的機器，可用年限比用專屬零件的長好幾年。

highlights.title: 標準零件才不會走進死路
highlights.body: 專屬主機板跟電源供應器會讓品牌機變成升不了級的機器。Lenovo 全程使用可替換零件，在一台被鎖死的系統變成消耗品之後，Legion Tower 還能繼續用好幾年。

highlights.title: Steam Machine 拿掉了 Windows 的包袱
highlights.body: Valve 的做法免掉作業系統這筆成本，定價也看得出這家公司沒在記憶體上加價。作為專職遊戲主機，這份專注帶來真正不同的價值主張。

highlights.title: 買之前先看記憶體加了多少
highlights.body: 好幾家廠商的 RAM 定價遠超過零件成本，而這正是今年決定品牌機划不划算的關鍵。拿規格去對現在的零件行情，再判斷買整機有沒有省到。

highlights.title: 升級自由度活得比規格久
highlights.body: 標準 ATX 電源加上可插拔零件，讓機器在原始配置過時之後還能用好幾年。第四年時這份彈性的價值，超過購買當下任何跑分優勢。

references.title: RAM price tracking 2026 — lowest price on DDR5 and DDR4 memory of all capacities
DDR5 Price Crisis 2026: How to Buy RAM Smart
Steam Machine priced at $1,049, Valve officially confirms

en.commentary:
The memory market is now the single biggest factor in this category, and I have adjusted for it. A 64GB DDR5-5600 kit that averaged 191 dollars in August 2025 was selling for 1,118 dollars by 17 August 2026, a 485 percent rise in a year, driven by fabs shifting capacity to HBM for AI accelerators. Nvidia has also raised board partner pricing three times this year, most recently by 20 to 30 percent this month.

That is why I have raised the Valve Steam Machine's memory markup score to 9.7 and its overall to 9.1. Its price is locked at 1,049 dollars with memory included, so while DIY builders watch a 32GB kit climb toward 400 dollars, that config risk simply is not yours. A sealed, fixed-price box is a genuinely different proposition in this market than it was a year ago.

The Lenovo Legion Tower 7i Gen 10 keeps first place on a 9.6 cost per frame score and 9.4 on upgrade freedom. In a year when memory is the expensive part, buying a machine that lets you add sticks later at your own timing is worth real money.

My blunt advice for anyone shopping now: buy the memory configuration you actually want on day one where the markup is reasonable, because the aftermarket is the expensive path this year. That reverses the standard advice, and the price data supports it.

highlights.title: Steam Machine memory markup raised to 9.7
highlights.body: Its 1,049 dollar price includes memory and is locked, so the DDR5 spike that is hitting DIY builders does not land on this buyer.

highlights.title: DDR5 is up 485 percent in a year
highlights.body: A 64GB DDR5-5600 kit averaged 191 dollars last August and reached 1,118 dollars by 17 August 2026 as fabs shifted capacity to HBM.

highlights.title: GPU pricing moved again this month
highlights.body: Nvidia raised board partner pricing for the third time this year, by roughly 20 to 30 percent, which flows into prebuilt sticker prices next quarter.

highlights.title: Buy the RAM config you want up front
highlights.body: With aftermarket kits at four to five times last year's price, paying a reasonable factory markup on day one is now the cheaper path.

zh-tw.commentary:
記憶體市場現在是這個類別最大的變數，我這次也照著調了分數。一組 64GB DDR5-5600 在 2025 年八月均價 191 美金，到 2026 年 8 月 17 日已經賣到 1,118 美金，一年漲了 485%，原因是晶圓廠把產能轉去做給 AI 加速器用的 HBM。Nvidia 今年也已經三度調漲給板卡廠的報價，最近一次就在這個月，幅度大概兩成到三成。

所以我把 Valve Steam Machine 的記憶體加價分數拉到 9.7，總分調到 9.1。它 1,049 美金的定價是含記憶體且鎖死的，當 DIY 玩家眼睜睜看著 32GB 一組往 400 美金爬的時候，這個風險早就被鎖在定價裡了。在現在這種行情，一台封裝好、價格固定的機器，價值跟一年前完全不同。

Lenovo Legion Tower 7i Gen 10 靠 9.6 的每幀成本跟 9.4 的升級自由度守住第一。在記憶體變成最貴零件的這一年，能讓你之後自己挑時間加條子的機器，省下來的是真金白銀。

我給現在要買的人一個直白的建議：第一天就把你要的記憶體容量買到位，只要原廠加價還算合理就下手。今年事後自己補記憶體才是貴的那條路，這跟以往的常識相反，但價格數據就是這樣講的。

highlights.title: Steam Machine 記憶體加價調到 9.7
highlights.body: 1,049 美金含記憶體、價格鎖死，DDR5 這波漲勢打不到這個買家身上。

highlights.title: DDR5 一年漲了 485%
highlights.body: 64GB DDR5-5600 從去年八月均價 191 美金，漲到今年 8 月 17 日的 1,118 美金，產能都被 HBM 吃走了。

highlights.title: 顯卡報價這個月又動了
highlights.body: Nvidia 今年第三次調漲板卡廠報價，幅度約兩到三成，下一季就會反映在整機標價上。

highlights.title: 記憶體第一天就買到位
highlights.body: 散裝條子已經是去年的四到五倍價，付合理的原廠加價現在反倒比較省。

Steam Machine priced at $1,049, Valve officially confirms

en.commentary: Valve prices the Steam Machine from $1,049 for the 512GB model and $1,349 for 2TB, which places it directly against entry prebuilt gaming PCs rather than against consoles. That comparison is the interesting one, and it is why I have it at 9.1 in second place. The Lenovo Legion Tower 7i Gen 10 holds first at 9.3 because it is the prebuilt I would recommend to someone who wants to open the case later. Standard ATX components, a proper power supply with headroom, and cooling that is sized for the hardware inside mean you can upgrade the graphics card in two years without replacing the machine. Too many prebuilts use proprietary parts that turn an upgrade into a rebuild. The Steam Machine at 9.1 is a genuinely different proposition. SteamOS handles updates and driver management invisibly, the form factor is small enough for a living room shelf, and your entire Steam library works. For someone who wants PC gaming without maintaining a PC, that is compelling. The HP Omen 35L at 8.8 offers strong thermals and sensible cable management. My advice: if you enjoy tinkering, buy the Legion. If you want it to just work, the Steam Machine earns its price.

highlights.title: The Legion Tower 7i wins on upgradeability
highlights.body: Standard ATX parts, a power supply with real headroom, and cooling sized for the components mean a graphics card swap in two years is a Saturday afternoon rather than a new purchase. Proprietary internals are how prebuilts quietly become disposable, and avoiding that earns 9.3.

highlights.title: The Steam Machine is for people who want gaming without maintenance
highlights.body: At $1,049 it costs what an entry prebuilt costs, and SteamOS removes driver management and update decisions entirely. Your full Steam library runs, the box fits on a living room shelf, and nothing asks for your attention. That is worth 9.1.

highlights.title: Compare total cost, not sticker price
highlights.body: A prebuilt with a weak power supply forces an upgrade you did not budget for. Check the wattage rating and whether the case takes standard parts before comparing prices, because those two details determine what the machine actually costs you over three years.

zh-tw.commentary:
Valve 把 Steam Machine 的價格訂在 512GB 版 1,049 美元、2TB 版 1,349 美元，這個定價讓它直接對上入門級的電競準系統，而不是對上主機。這個比較才有意思，也是我給它 9.1 分坐第二的原因。

Lenovo Legion Tower 7i Gen 10 以 9.3 分守第一，因為它是我會推薦給「以後打算自己開機殼」的人的那台。標準 ATX 零件、瓦數有餘裕的正經電源、散熱規格跟裡面的硬體匹配，代表你兩年後想換顯卡不用整台換掉。太多品牌機用專規零件，結果升級變成重組一台。

Steam Machine 9.1 分則是完全不同的提案。SteamOS 把更新跟驅動管理處理到你察覺不到，體積小到可以放客廳層架上，而且你整個 Steam 遊戲庫都能跑。對想玩 PC 遊戲但不想維護一台 PC 的人來說，這很有吸引力。

HP Omen 35L 8.8 分，散熱扎實、理線也做得合理。

建議是：喜歡動手折騰就買 Legion；只想要它乖乖運作，Steam Machine 值那個價。

highlights.title: Legion Tower 7i 贏在可升級性
highlights.body: 標準 ATX 零件、瓦數有餘裕的電源、跟硬體匹配的散熱，代表兩年後換顯卡是一個週六下午的事，而不是重買一台。專規內部設計就是品牌機悄悄變成消耗品的原因，避開這個坑就值 9.3 分。

highlights.title: Steam Machine 給的是「不用維護的遊戲體驗」
highlights.body: 1,049 美元跟入門品牌機同價，SteamOS 把驅動管理跟更新決策整個拿掉。你完整的 Steam 遊戲庫都能跑，機身放得進客廳層架，而且它不會來煩你。這值 9.1 分。

highlights.title: 比的是總成本，不是標價
highlights.body: 電源瓦數不足的品牌機，會逼你做一次沒編進預算的升級。比價之前先看電源瓦數、再看機殼吃不吃標準零件，這兩個細節決定這台機器三年下來到底花你多少錢。

references.title: Nvidia unveils RTX Spark Superchip for laptops and desktop PCs at Computex 2026

en.commentary:
Nvidia's RTX Spark platform is coming to compact desktops as well as laptops this fall, and that is relevant to anyone considering a small form factor prebuilt. Pricing is still unannounced as of late August, and the platform pairs an Arm CPU with a Blackwell GPU and up to 128GB of unified memory. For a gaming-first buyer I would not wait for it. Arm on Windows will have compatibility work to do and RTX 50-series Blackwell desktop cards remain the right answer for playing games today.

The Lenovo Legion Tower 7i Gen 10 holds first at 9.3 because it gets the boring things right. Standard components throughout, so you can upgrade or repair it yourself. Cooling that handles the parts inside it under sustained load. A power supply with real headroom rather than one sized exactly to the original configuration. Prebuilt machines fail on those points far more often than on raw performance, and Lenovo does not.

The Valve Steam Machine at 9.1 is the interesting one and I keep watching it. SteamOS on a living room box removes the entire Windows maintenance burden, and for a machine that sits under a television that is a genuine advantage.

One piece of advice that has not changed: check the power supply and the case airflow before you check the graphics card. A prebuilt with a great GPU and a marginal power supply is a machine you will be repairing rather than upgrading.

highlights.title: The Legion Tower 7i wins on the boring things that determine ownership
highlights.body: Standard components you can upgrade yourself, cooling sized for the parts actually inside it, and a power supply with genuine headroom. Prebuilt machines fail on those points far more often than on benchmarks. At 9.3 Lenovo gets all three right, which is rarer than it should be.

highlights.title: Do not wait for RTX Spark if gaming is your priority
highlights.body: Arm-based compact desktops arrive this fall with no pricing announced. First-generation Arm on Windows will have compatibility work ahead of it. RTX 50-series Blackwell desktop cards remain the correct answer for playing games right now, and they are available at known prices today.

highlights.title: The Steam Machine removes the Windows maintenance burden
highlights.body: For a box that lives under a television, SteamOS means no driver updates interrupting a session and no desktop to manage. At 9.1 that is a genuine advantage rather than a novelty, and it is the machine in this ranking I am most curious about heading into autumn.

highlights.title: Check the power supply before you check the GPU
highlights.body: A prebuilt with an excellent graphics card and a power supply sized exactly to the original configuration is a machine you will repair rather than upgrade. Look at wattage headroom and case airflow first. Those two numbers predict how the machine ages far better than the GPU model does.

zh-tw.commentary:
Nvidia 的 RTX Spark 平台這個秋天不只進筆電，也會進小型桌機，這對考慮小機殼準系統的人有關係。到八月底價格還沒公布，這個平台是 Arm CPU 配 Blackwell GPU、最高 128GB 統一記憶體。

如果你買機器主要是為了打遊戲，我不會等它。Windows on Arm 的相容性還有一段路要磨，而 RTX 50 系列的 Blackwell 桌上型顯卡，到今天為止還是「現在就要玩遊戲」的正確答案。

Lenovo Legion Tower 7i Gen 10 守住第一 9.3 分，因為它把無聊的事做對了。從頭到尾都是標準規格零件，你自己就能升級或維修。散熱是照著裡面實際塞的東西設計的。電源供應器留了真正的餘裕，而不是剛好卡在出廠配置的瓦數。準系統翻船翻在這些地方的次數，遠多過翻在效能上，而聯想沒有翻。

Valve Steam Machine 9.1 分，是有趣的那一台，我一直在觀察。SteamOS 放在客廳的盒子上，等於把整套 Windows 維護負擔拿掉，對一台放在電視下面的機器來說，這是實質優勢。

一個一直沒變的建議：先看電源供應器跟機殼風道，再看顯卡。一台配了好顯卡但電供剛好卡死的準系統，你之後會在修它，而不是在升級它。

highlights.title: Legion Tower 7i 贏在那些決定「持有體驗」的無聊事
highlights.body: 全部標準零件、自己就能升級，散熱是照著裡面實際的東西設計的，電源供應器留了真正的餘裕。準系統翻船翻在這些地方遠多過翻在跑分上。9.3 分，聯想三件都做對了，而這比想像中稀有。

highlights.title: 主要是打遊戲的話，不要等 RTX Spark
highlights.body: Arm 架構的小型桌機秋天登場，價格未公布。第一代 Windows on Arm 的相容性還有工要做。RTX 50 系列的 Blackwell 桌上顯卡仍然是「現在就要玩」的正確答案，而且今天就買得到、價格是已知的。

highlights.title: Steam Machine 拿掉了整套 Windows 維護負擔
highlights.body: 對一台住在電視下面的盒子來說，SteamOS 代表不會有驅動更新打斷你玩到一半，也沒有桌面要管。9.1 分，這是實質優勢不是新鮮感，也是這張榜上我對這個秋天最好奇的一台。

highlights.title: 先看電源供應器，再看顯卡
highlights.body: 一台配了好顯卡、電供瓦數卻剛好卡死在出廠配置的準系統，你以後會在修它而不是升級它。先看瓦數餘裕跟機殼風道。這兩個數字預測機器怎麼變老，準確度遠高過顯卡型號。
